findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The learning window is the observed score-time grid 0.0-0.49 with curve support 0.0-0.49 and recorded affinities removed under an equal score prior, so all coordinate contrasts are selection/score-clock observations rather than absolute affinity measurements.

Continuous contrast features are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed and polynomial fits not accepted; several landmark local features show large first-to-last rate reversals (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z -72.4 to last_rate_z +5.5; landmark_00_local_cyy -36.5 to +17.1) with multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, indicating time-conditioned rather than constant contrast behavior.

Fit fidelity varies across features: landmark_00_soft_mass has relative node RMSE 0.286 with whole-window z 0.639, while landmark_00_local_dx has RMSE 0.782 with 9 strong sign conflicts and whole-window z -0.184, so point-estimate ranking alone would over-rank the poorly fit local derivative features relative to the better-fit soft-mass feature.

Landmark_00_local_dz shows 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts with whole-window z near zero (-0.024), so its marginal descriptor carries little coherent whole-window information and should not be treated as a stable directional target.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant-sign rule matching the observed-node contrast trajectory within fit RMSE would falsify the need for time conditioning.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule that follows the observed-node contrast trajectory of landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy (sign-reversing, rate-changing) would express the observed within-window change better than a constant-sign rule, because the observed-node linear fits show large first-to-last rate reversals with multiple sign changes.

hypotheses.falsifier: If local derivative features had equal or better fit fidelity and fewer conflicts, the ranking would not change.
hypotheses.statement: Prioritizing landmark_00_soft_mass over the poorly fit local derivative features for coordinate hypotheses would change the ranking relative to point estimates alone, because soft_mass has lower relative node RMSE and fewer strong sign conflicts than local_dx/local_dz.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the descendant-survival versus immediate-selection comparison is unavailable.

No joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects, increment_effects or turnover_accounting rows were read in this turn, so coupling, redundancy, ancestral coverage and survivor-bias questions remain unassessed.
Contrast curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies; no neural-module causation is claimed.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and were not proposed or edited.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
